# v0.8.1 — Plug & Charge for cars plugged in later

Integration fix release. The app stays at **0.8.0**; no app update is needed.

- **Virtual Plug & Charge and automatic selection** now recognize a car that is
  plugged in long after parking. A parked car sends no new position, so after
  30 minutes its location no longer counted and the wallbox stayed locked. A
  plug report within two minutes of the wallbox seeing the car now counts
  together with the car's last known position at home; a fresh position
  elsewhere still excludes the car.
- **Session duration** is shown in hours and minutes, e.g. **1 h 15 min**. A
  sensor created with 0.8.0 keeps seconds; choose **h** as its unit in the
  entity settings.
